document.abstract: The Alliance for Open Media (AOMedia)1 has been continuing its work on media-related specifications since the SMPTE progress report in 2022.2 Updates on selected activities from the alliance’s working groups are given below. For general information about AOMedia, the reader is referred to the 2022 AOMedia progress report.2

authors.bio: Andrey Norkin is a co-chair of the Alliance for Open Media’s (AOM’s) Royalty-Free Video Codec Working Group (CWG). He is a research scientist at Netflix and has also been involved in the development of encoding techniques for OTT video streaming.
authors.name: Andrey Norkin

authors.bio: Adrian Grange is a member of Google’s Open Codecs Team and was an active contributor to the VPx and AV1 video codecs. He is a co-chair of the Alliance for Open Media’s Royalty-Free Video Codec Working Group (CWG).
authors.name: Adrian Grange

authors.bio: Jani Huoponen works as a group product manager at Google Open Media team. In his current role, he is a member of AOMedia Storage and Transport Formats WG as well as Audio Codec WG, actively driving the development of next generation audio formats.
authors.name: Jani Huoponen

authors.bio: Cyril Concolato is a software engineer working on studio and streaming technologies at Netflix. He is the chair of AOM’s Storage and Transport Format Working Group (STF WG) and an editor of various AOM specifications.
authors.name: Cyril Concolato

authors.bio: Ioannis Katsavounidis is a research scientist with the Video Infrastructure Team at Meta. He is a co-chair of AOM’s Software Implementation Working Group (SIWG).
authors.name: Ioannis Katsavounidis

authors.bio: Hassene Tmar is a technical program manager for media at Meta. He continues to hold the software coordinator of the SVT-AV1 code base after being adopted by the AOM SIWG since August 2020.
authors.name: Hassene Tmar

authors.bio: Tim Harris works as an engineering manager at Meta in Video Infra. For AOM, he is the current chair of the AOM Audio Codec WG.
authors.name: Tim Harris

authors.bio: Roman Cherniak is a principal engineer at Tencent America. He is a co-chair of the Software Implementation Working group in the Alliance for Open Media.
authors.name: Roman Cherniak

authors.bio: Khaled Mammou is a senior engineer at Apple working on designing 3D compression solutions. He is the co-chair of the AOMedia Volumetric Visual Media Working Group.
authors.name: Khaled Mammou

authors.bio: Shan Liu is currently a distinguished scientist and a general manager at Tencent. She is a co-chair of the AOMedia Volumetric Visual Media Working Group.
authors.name: Shan Liu
